intro.en: Custom EMI-shielded cable assemblies control electromagnetic coupling through cable geometry, foil or braid, connector termination, bonding and—where justified—ferrite components. The design starts with the noise source, affected circuit, frequency range and installation path, then defines a build and validation plan.
intro.zh: 定制 EMI 屏蔽电缆组件通过线缆几何、铝箔或编织屏蔽、连接器端接、搭接接地，以及在确有需要时使用铁氧体器件，控制电磁耦合。设计先识别噪声源、受扰回路、频率范围与安装路径，再形成结构和验证方案。

knowledge.en: A shield is part of a system, not a decorative cable layer. Performance depends on coverage, resistance and inductance, connector-shell continuity, enclosure bonding, routing and frequency. Ferrite can add common-mode impedance over a selected band, but it does not repair an undefined return path or poor shield termination.
knowledge.zh: 屏蔽层属于系统的一部分，不是线缆上的装饰层。实际性能取决于覆盖率、电阻与电感、连接器外壳连续性、机壳搭接、走线和频率。铁氧体可在特定频段增加共模阻抗，但不能修复未定义的回流路径或错误的屏蔽端接。

notes.en: For quotation, provide the interface and pin map, signal or power type, expected spectrum or switching source, cable length and routing, nearby drives or radios, connector-shell and chassis details, flex and environment, target standard, representative equipment and acceptance method.
notes.zh: 报价请提供接口与针脚、信号或电源类型、预期频谱或开关噪声源、长度与走线、附近变频器或无线设备、连接器外壳与机壳结构、弯曲和环境、目标标准、代表设备与验收方法。

delivery.en: Released documents identify conductors and pair lay, shield construction and coverage, drain wire, jacket, connector and backshell, shield-trim and termination method, ferrite part and location when used, grounding notes, dimensions, labels and agreed inspection or EMC test conditions.
delivery.zh: 放行文件记录导体与线对绞距、屏蔽结构和覆盖、排流线、护套、连接器与尾附件、屏蔽修整和端接方式；使用铁氧体时还要记录型号与位置，并包含接地说明、尺寸、标签及约定的检验或 EMC 测试条件。

subtitle.en: Control the coupling path—not just the cable appearance.
subtitle.zh: 控制电磁耦合路径，而不只是改变线缆外观

lead.en: Electromagnetic compatibility is a relationship between a source, a victim and a coupling path. Cable shielding works only when pair geometry, shield material, connector transition, enclosure bond and installation route support the same frequency-domain objective.
lead.zh: 电磁兼容描述的是噪声源、受扰对象与耦合路径之间的关系。只有线对几何、屏蔽材料、连接器过渡、机壳搭接与安装走线共同服务于同一频域目标时，线缆屏蔽才真正有意义。

title.en: Start with Source, Victim and Coupling Path
title.zh: 先确定噪声源、受扰回路与耦合路径

copy.en: A variable-frequency drive, switching power supply, relay, motor cable or radio transmitter can inject noise by conduction, capacitive coupling, magnetic induction or radiation. The affected circuit may be a low-level sensor, encoder, analog input, industrial network or high-speed data link. We document frequency range, common-mode and differential-mode behavior, physical separation, return path and enclosure boundary before choosing a shield or ferrite. Without that map, added metal can move the problem rather than solve it.
copy.zh: 变频器、开关电源、继电器、电机线或无线发射器可能通过传导、电容耦合、磁感应或辐射引入噪声；受扰对象可能是微弱传感器、编码器、模拟量输入、工业网络或高速数据链路。选屏蔽或铁氧体之前，应记录频率范围、共模与差模特征、物理间距、回流路径和机壳边界。没有这张关系图，增加金属层可能只是把问题转移到别处。

title.en: Foil, Braid and Composite Shields Serve Different Jobs
title.zh: 铝箔、编织与复合屏蔽承担不同任务

copy.en: Foil offers high coverage with low bulk and is useful around individual pairs, but repeated flexing and termination require care. Copper braid provides a lower-resistance, mechanically robust path and better flex life, while coverage depends on braid angle and density. Foil-plus-braid constructions combine coverage and current-carrying capability at the cost of diameter, stiffness and assembly work. Conductive tape, spiral serve and separate pair shields are selected by spectrum, motion, space and termination—not by a universal ranking.
copy.zh: 铝箔屏蔽覆盖率高、体积小，适合包覆单独线对，但反复弯曲和端接需要谨慎；铜编织可形成更低电阻、更耐机械动作的路径，覆盖率则受编织角度与密度影响。铝箔加编织可同时兼顾覆盖与电流承载能力，但会增加直径、刚度和装配工作。导电带、螺旋缠绕与分对屏蔽都应按频谱、运动、空间和端接条件选择，而不是套用固定排名。

title.en: Preserve Pair Balance Before Adding More Metal
title.zh: 增加屏蔽之前，先保持线对平衡

copy.en: Twisted pairs reduce loop area and help equalize external coupling into differential circuits. Pair assignment, twist lay, conductor symmetry, impedance, return reference and the untwisted length at a terminal all affect performance. Ethernet, CAN, RS-422/RS-485, LVDS, encoder and analog-instrument circuits cannot be treated as identical simply because each uses two wires. Branches, splices and connector transitions should preserve the intended pair and avoid long parallel exposure beside power conductors.
copy.zh: 双绞结构缩小回路面积，并帮助差分回路均衡承受外部耦合。线对分配、绞距、导体对称性、阻抗、回流参考以及端子处的解绞长度都会影响性能。以太网、CAN、RS-422/RS-485、LVDS、编码器和模拟仪表虽然都可能使用两根线，却不能按同一种结构处理；分支、接点与连接器过渡应保持既定线对，并避免与动力线长距离并行。

title.en: The Connector Transition Determines Shield Continuity
title.zh: 连接器过渡决定屏蔽连续性

copy.en: At higher frequencies, a long drain-wire pigtail adds inductance and can create an aperture between cable shield and enclosure. When the connector and system require it, a controlled 360-degree clamp, conductive backshell, shield ring or EMC gland can continue the shield around the transition. Shell plating, contact area, surface finish, corrosion, strain relief and service disassembly matter. A shield that is excellent along the cable but poorly transferred at the endpoint may deliver weak system-level attenuation.
copy.zh: 频率升高后，较长的排流线尾线会增加电感，并可能在线缆屏蔽与机壳之间形成开口。连接器和系统需要时，可采用受控的 360° 压接、导电尾附件、屏蔽环或 EMC 电缆接头，使屏蔽在过渡处连续。外壳镀层、接触面积、表面状态、腐蚀、应力释放与拆装维护都要审核。线身屏蔽再好，如果端点转接不连续，系统衰减仍可能很弱。

title.en: Bond Shield, Shell and Chassis to the System Architecture
title.zh: 屏蔽、外壳与机壳接法要服从系统架构

copy.en: There is no single rule that every shield must connect at one end or both ends. The decision depends on frequency, safety bonding, ground potential, enclosure construction, common-mode current and equipment EMC design. Signal ground, protective earth, chassis and cable shield are different nodes until the drawing intentionally connects them. We define the connection at each endpoint, including isolated, capacitive or direct bonds when the equipment design calls for them, and avoid using incidental mounting hardware as an undocumented current path.
copy.zh: 不存在所有屏蔽都必须单端或双端连接的通用规则。接法取决于频率、安全接地、地电位差、机壳结构、共模电流和设备 EMC 架构。信号地、保护地、机壳地与线缆屏蔽在图纸明确连接前属于不同节点。我们会定义每个端点的连接方式，包括设备设计需要的隔离、电容耦合或直接搭接，并避免把普通安装五金当作未记录的电流路径。

title.en: Ferrite Impedance Must Match Frequency and Current
title.zh: 铁氧体阻抗必须匹配频率与电流

copy.en: Clamp-on cores, rings, sleeves and cable-integrated ferrites add frequency-dependent impedance, most often to common-mode current when all relevant conductors pass through together. Material mix, core dimensions, number of turns, conductor bundle, DC bias, temperature and installation position determine the useful band. Passing only one conductor through a core changes the circuit and saturation risk. Ferrite is therefore a measured tuning element—not a generic badge for an EMI cable and not a substitute for a missing shield return.
copy.zh: 卡扣磁环、环形磁芯、套管与线缆一体式铁氧体会增加随频率变化的阻抗；当相关导体一起穿过磁芯时，通常主要作用于共模电流。材料配方、磁芯尺寸、匝数、导体束、直流偏置、温度和安装位置共同决定有效频段。只让单根导体穿芯会改变电路与饱和风险。因此铁氧体是需要测量和调试的器件，不是 EMI 线缆的通用标签，也不能替代缺失的屏蔽回流路径。

title.en: High-Speed Data Needs Controlled Geometry Through the Endpoint
title.zh: 高速数据要把受控几何延续到端点

copy.en: For USB, Ethernet, LVDS, DisplayPort-class links, cameras and other high-speed channels, shielding is only one part of signal integrity. Differential impedance, skew, insertion loss, return loss, crosstalk, pair-to-pair balance and connector launch geometry can dominate. Shield splices and branch transitions should avoid abrupt diameter or reference changes. The target protocol, data rate, length, cable category, mating connector and board-side launch must be known before committing to a construction.
copy.zh: 对 USB、以太网、LVDS、DisplayPort 类链路、相机和其他高速通道而言，屏蔽只是信号完整性的一部分；差分阻抗、时延偏差、插入损耗、回波损耗、串扰、线对平衡与连接器引出几何都可能成为主导因素。屏蔽接点和分支过渡应避免直径或参考平面突变。确定结构前，需要明确目标协议、速率、长度、线缆类别、对插件与板端引出。

title.en: Motor and Drive Cables Need a Low-Impedance High-Frequency Return
title.zh: 电机与驱动线需要低阻抗的高频回流路径

copy.en: PWM drives and inverter-fed motors create fast voltage edges and common-mode currents that can couple into encoder, sensor and network wiring. Cable separation, bonded metallic enclosure, shielded motor cable, symmetric protective-earth conductors, connector glands and short enclosure bonds are reviewed as a route. Current, voltage, conductor temperature, flex and safety remain separate design requirements; an EMC-oriented shield cannot be used to justify an undersized power conductor or unsupported insulation rating.
copy.zh: PWM 驱动器与逆变电机产生快速电压边沿和共模电流，可能耦合到编码器、传感器与网络线。线缆间距、金属机壳搭接、屏蔽电机线、对称保护地导体、连接器接头和短机壳连接应作为一条路径整体审核。电流、电压、导体温升、弯曲与安全仍是独立要求；面向 EMC 的屏蔽不能用来证明过小导体或无依据绝缘等级合理。

title.en: Sensors, Motion, Medical, Test and Vehicle Electronics
title.zh: 传感、运动、医疗、测试与车辆电子应用

copy.en: Shielded custom harnesses are used around low-level instrumentation, load cells, thermocouples, encoders, servo feedback, industrial Ethernet, cameras, laboratory equipment, medical devices, test fixtures, automotive control modules and battery or inverter systems. Each application changes the dominant coupling path, grounding boundary, movement, cleaning, temperature and documentation. Product names and interface families guide the review, but final compatibility comes from the equipment circuit and representative installation.
copy.zh: 定制屏蔽线束可用于微弱仪表、称重传感器、热电偶、编码器、伺服反馈、工业以太网、相机、实验室设备、医疗设备、测试夹具、汽车控制模块，以及电池或逆变系统。不同应用会改变主要耦合路径、接地边界、运动、清洁、温度与文件要求。产品名称和接口家族只能引导审核，最终兼容性仍由设备电路与代表性安装决定。

title.en: Separate Production Inspection from EMC Evidence
title.zh: 区分生产检验与 EMC 性能证据

copy.en: Production controls can verify continuity, shorts, conductor resistance, shield-to-shell path, shield DC resistance, dimensions, termination workmanship and label traceability. Cable-screening measurements may use transfer impedance or screening attenuation methods such as those described in the IEC 62153-4 series, with fixtures and frequency limits defined. Emissions and immunity belong to the representative product or system test plan. Passing a continuity test—or using foil, braid or ferrite—does not by itself prove regulatory EMC compliance.
copy.zh: 生产控制可检查导通、短路、导体电阻、屏蔽到外壳路径、屏蔽直流电阻、尺寸、端接工艺与标签追溯。线缆屏蔽性能可按项目定义夹具和频率范围，采用 IEC 62153-4 系列所述的转移阻抗或屏蔽衰减等方法；发射与抗扰度则属于代表产品或系统的测试计划。通过导通测试，或使用了铝箔、编织与铁氧体，都不能单独证明法规 EMC 合规。

inputs.en: Noise source, switching frequency or spectrum, victim circuit and observed symptom
inputs.zh: 噪声源、开关频率或频谱、受扰回路与已观察到的现象

inputs.en: Interface, mating connector, pin map, signal standard, data rate, power and current
inputs.zh: 接口、对插件、针脚、信号标准、速率、功率与电流

inputs.en: Cable length, route, separation, enclosure entry, chassis and grounding architecture
inputs.zh: 长度、走线、间距、机壳入口、机壳与接地架构

inputs.en: Foil, braid, drain, pair shield, ferrite or connector-shell requirement if already specified
inputs.zh: 已指定的铝箔、编织、排流线、分对屏蔽、铁氧体或连接器外壳要求

inputs.en: Flex, bend radius, vibration, temperature, oil, cleaning, ingress and installation service needs
inputs.zh: 弯曲、弯曲半径、振动、温度、油污、清洁、防护与安装维护需求

inputs.en: Target EMC standard, cable test method, system configuration, sample quantity and acceptance limits
inputs.zh: 目标 EMC 标准、线缆测试方法、系统配置、样品数量与验收限值

q.en: Is a shielded cable automatically EMC compliant?
q.zh: 用了屏蔽线就一定符合 EMC 吗？

a.en: No. Cable construction, endpoint termination, enclosure bond, routing and the complete equipment configuration all affect emissions and immunity. Compliance needs an agreed representative test.
a.zh: 不一定。线缆结构、端点转接、机壳搭接、走线与整机配置都会影响发射和抗扰度，合规需要约定的代表性测试。

q.en: Should the shield connect at one end or both ends?
q.zh: 屏蔽层应该单端接地还是双端接地？

a.en: There is no universal answer. Frequency, safety, ground potential, chassis structure and common-mode current determine the architecture. We need the complete system drawing before freezing the connection.
a.zh: 没有通用答案。频率、安全、地电位、机壳结构与共模电流共同决定架构，冻结接法前需要完整系统图。

q.zh: 铝箔屏蔽一定比编织屏蔽好吗？

a.en: Neither is universally better. Foil, braid and composite shields trade coverage, resistance, flex life, diameter, mass and termination work. Selection follows the spectrum and installed duty cycle.
a.zh: 两者没有绝对优劣。铝箔、编织和复合屏蔽在覆盖、电阻、弯曲寿命、直径、重量与端接工作上各有取舍，应按频谱与装机工况选择。

q.en: Can a clamp-on ferrite solve any interference problem?
q.zh: 加一个卡扣磁环能解决所有干扰吗？

a.en: No. Ferrite impedance is frequency-, material-, geometry-, current- and installation-dependent. The interference mode and cable path should be measured or otherwise defined first.
a.zh: 不能。铁氧体阻抗受频率、材料、几何、电流和安装方式影响，应先测量或明确干扰模式与线缆路径。

q.en: Can you manufacture shielded Ethernet, CAN, encoder and servo cables?
q.zh: 可以定制屏蔽以太网、CAN、编码器与伺服线吗？

a.en: Yes, when the interface, cable electrical requirements, connector and shield termination are defined. The same shield construction is not assumed suitable for every protocol or motion duty.
a.zh: 可以，但要明确接口、线缆电气要求、连接器与屏蔽端接；不会假设同一种屏蔽结构适合所有协议与运动工况。

a.en: Production inspection can cover wiring, resistance, shield and shell paths, dimensions and workmanship. Transfer impedance, screening attenuation, emissions, immunity or environmental tests require separately defined fixtures, frequency range, system configuration and acceptance limits.
a.zh: 生产检验可覆盖接线、电阻、屏蔽与外壳路径、尺寸和工艺；转移阻抗、屏蔽衰减、发射、抗扰度或环境测试需要单独定义夹具、频率范围、系统配置与限值。
